name: Anthropic API

estimatedTokenBudget.description: Direct API PAYG ($20 buys ~10M conservative / ~18M cached-agent Sonnet 5 tokens)
estimatedTokenBudget.assumptions: $20 at Sonnet 5 ($2/M in, $10/M out): 5M on a 3:1 input:output list blend; ~18M on the standard 20K-in/1K-out agent request with 75% cache at 90% off; the 10M floor allows mixed Opus-class use and lower cache rates

estimateMeta.sourceQuote: Claude Sonnet 5 $2 / MTok input, $10 / MTok output; cache reads 0.1x input

gotchas: Rate limits and spend caps are tiered by cumulative spend (Start $500, Build $1,000, Scale $200,000+/mo); new accounts hit 429s on large codebases
Thinking/reasoning tokens are billed at standard output token rates
Cache write operations cost 25% more than base input tokens
tosHighlights: Anthropic does not train models on API inputs or outputs
Commercial IP indemnity provided under commercial terms of service
stackingPolicyNote: Consumer/commercial terms ban sharing account credentials and API keys but do not address one person holding multiple paid accounts.
